title: Grrrrr! I hate usage limits! So I built this...
author: 2FingOldForThisShit
selftext:
Screw constantly running into usage limits! 😂

I don't know about you guys, but I use ChatGPT pretty heavily for development.

Normally, if you want AI to work directly on your PC, you'd use something like Codex or another desktop coding agent. And if you're anything like me, sooner or later you hit your usage limits and have to wait for them to reset.

The alternative is to use regular ChatGPT in your browser, which I actually prefer for a lot of things. But then you have another problem: your files are on your PC, and you end up constantly uploading documents, downloading modified versions, and manually copying things back and forth.

So I got fed up and built my own solution. 😅

I called it **Friction Tamer Dev Bridge (FTDB)**.

Basically, it connects ChatGPT (and Claude and other AI models, but I've been mostly using it with ChatGPT) to your Windows PC through a secure connection, allowing it to actually work on folders and projects you've explicitly approved and this way I effectively have unlimited usage.

That means you can ask ChatGPT to:

* Read and modify files directly on your PC.
* Work on existing software projects without constantly uploading files.
* Run builds and tests.
* Check what changed and continue working on the project.
* Even do some of this from your phone while you're away from your computer!

It also supports other AI assistants and local models, although personally I've been using it mostly with ChatGPT, and so far I'm really happy with how well it's working.

I originally built it to solve my own frustration, but I figured other developers might find it useful too.

There's a free version, and a one-time paid Pro version with more advanced functionality or if you want to support me.

[https://frictiontamer.com/ft-dev-bridge/](https://frictiontamer.com/ft-dev-bridge/)
